extDescription.message: Analyzes YouTube videos with the Gemini API into a report with a table of contents and chapter-by-chapter breakdown (own API key)

rateLimited.message: You've used all of today's analyses ($1 per day).

popupWatchPageOnly.message: Open a YouTube video page to analyze it.

popupLimitReached.message: You've reached today's analysis limit. Try again tomorrow.

optionsApiKeyDescHtml.message: Enter an API key issued from Google AI Studio. The key is kept in storage that syncs across your devices (chrome.storage.sync).

optionsNoKeyToTest.message: There's no API key to test. Enter one first.

optionsKeyNetworkError.message: ❌ Couldn't check because of a network error.

optionsReportLanguageHint.message: Automatic writes in Korean when your browser is set to Korean, and in English otherwise. The language spoken in the video doesn't matter.

optionsShareAttribution.message: Include the original video and a source link (Made with ViewDigest) when copying or downloading

optionsDailyLimitInvalid.message: The daily limit must be a number of 1 or more.

optionsChannelsDesc.message: Once you add a channel, only videos uploaded after that are analyzed automatically. (Videos already on the channel when you add it are not.) Channels are checked only while the browser is open.

optionsReadFromPage.message: read from the channel page instead of RSS

optionsEnterChannel.message: Enter a channel URL, @handle, or channel ID.

optionsIntervalInvalid.message: The check interval must be at least 5 minutes.

resultsAlreadyAnalyzed.message: You already analyzed this video ($1), so here is the saved report. Analyzing again costs another analysis.

reviewText.message: You've analyzed $1 videos so far. A short review on the Chrome Web Store helps other people find ViewDigest.

resultsNotFound.message: Couldn't find this saved analysis. It may have been deleted.

resultsUnknownError.message: An unknown error occurred during the analysis.

resultsNoUrl.message: No video URL to analyze. This page can only be opened from a ViewDigest analyze button.

contentOpenFailedDetail.message: An error occurred while opening a new tab.

bgAlreadyAnalyzing.message: This video is already being analyzed.

bgMissingKeyBody.message: No Gemini API key is set, so new videos from your channels weren't analyzed. Click to add a key; they'll be analyzed at the next check.

bgRateLimitedBody.message: You've used all of today's analyses ($1 per day). New videos from your channels will be analyzed tomorrow. Click to change the limit.

geminiVideoTooLong.message: This video is too long for Gemini to analyze in one request (it exceeds the input token limit). Try a shorter video.

geminiVideoNotAccessible.message: Gemini couldn't access this video (permission denied). It may be a premiere or live stream that hasn't started, a stream in progress, a video still processing after upload, or a private, unlisted, members-only or age-restricted video. If every video fails this way, check your API key's permissions.

geminiMaxTokens.message: Gemini hit its maximum output token limit before writing the report, so the response was cut off. The video may be very long or cover a lot of information. Please try again in a moment.

geminiSafety.message: Gemini's safety policy blocked the response for this video.

geminiRecitation.message: Gemini stopped generating because the output was too similar to the original content.

geminiNoData.message: The connection closed before Gemini sent any data. Please try again in a moment.

geminiBlocked.message: Gemini blocked the request for this video. (Reason: $1)

geminiInvalidUrl.message: This isn't a valid YouTube video URL.

geminiMissingKey.message: No Gemini API key is set. Add one on the options page first.

geminiUnknownError.message: An unknown error occurred while calling the Gemini API.

geminiAnalyzing.message: Gemini is analyzing the video. It may take a while before the first text appears...

channelEnterInput.message: Enter a channel URL or ID.

channelIdNotFound.message: Couldn't find the channel ID. Check that the channel URL is correct.

channelPageNoVideos.message: no videos found on the channel page
